children: BlackRock has built three investment portfolios that will trade as digital tokens, marking the asset manager's latest push to bring traditional assets to the alternative financial system that powers cryptocurrencies.

The world's largest asset manager's model portfolios, or preset investing templates, will be tokenized by Ondo Finance. In tokenized form, funds, stocks and other assets can trade on the blockchain, the digital ledger that underpins many cryptocurrencies.

Model portfolios have emerged as a popular way for financial advisers to outsource investment decisions to professional investors. According to Broadridge Financial Solutions, 87% of the 400 advisers it surveyed said they used them, with 25% noting they used them exclusively. And they are gaining momentum; total assets within the portfolios surged to $9.8 trillion in June from $7.7 trillion a year earlier.
The new portfolios will be the first BlackRock has designed to be tokenized by another firm.
Ondo is launching seven tokenized model portfolios on Thursday, including the three from BlackRock: high-income, diversified growth and high-growth.

The BlackRock portfolios will hold a mix of stock, bond and bitcoin exchange-traded funds depending on their profile. Ondo will issue a token tracking each of the portfolios. As investors buy them, self-executing software automatically buys shares in the underlying ETFs that make up the portfolio.

The model portfolios will initially be available to non-U. S. investors, who won't have direct shareholders rights in the underlying securities held. Investors will be able to borrow against their tokens, transfer them and trade them 24/7.

The BlackRock portfolios will help meet the needs of Ondo's customers who have been eager to buy into various investment funds on the blockchain and hold their stakes in a crypto wallet rather than a brokerage account, said John Hoffman, Ondo's head of product portfolios.
"For a long time, many people in the world have not had access to BlackRock strategies," said Hoffman.

BlackRock has been a believer in tokenization, with CEO Larry Fink calling it the "next generation for markets." The company launched its first tokenized money-market fund in 2024 and has also invested in tokenization firm Securitize.

Tokenization has been gaining momentum throughout Wall Street. Both the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq are readying their tokenization platforms. And JPMorgan Chase and Invesco have also rolled out tokenized funds.

The Securities and Exchange Commission recently cleared the path for tokenized stocks to trade in the U.S. by introducing two temporary five-year innovation exemptions. However, the SEC's guidelines exclude synthetic tokens or third-party tracker tokens that only provide the price exposure without the full rights of the underlying equity.
Ondo Finance is one of the biggest providers of tokenized products, with about $3.9 billion in tokenized assets under management on its platform.
